sections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
sections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Quboid Qube Cell Technology Mattress? The Quboid is a premium medium soft mattress from Duroflex's Energise collection featuring proprietary Qube Cell Technology—a unique cube-like foam structure combining high-density and high-resilient foam. It incorporates a 3-Zone Copper Infused NRG Layer, anti-stress technology, and cooling features designed to enhance sleep quality and overall wellness. 2. What problem does Quboid solve? It addresses multiple sleep concerns: poor temperature regulation, stressed muscles and joint tension, inadequate body support across different sleep positions, and electromagnetic stress. The mattress helps users rest deeper, wake up revitalized, and feel energized throughout the day. 3. Who is Quboid best for? The mattress is engineered for versatility and suits all sleep styles, body types, and lifestyles. It's ideal for people with active lifestyle, stressed muscles, joint pain, sleepers prone to night sweat, and anyone seeking a balance of comfort, cooling technology, and adaptive support. 4. How does Quboid work? The Qube Cell Technology maximizes airflow for cooler sleep while providing precise body support. The 3-Zone Copper Infused NRG Layer de-stresses muscles and joints, with NRG grooves that contour body curves and enable circulation. Copper ions provide cooling, while anti-stress technology shields against electromagnetic rays and repels negative ions. 5. How is Quboid different from alternatives? The Quboid stands out with its patented Qube Cell foam structure (combining high-density and high-resilient foam), 3-Zone differentiated body support system, copper ion cooling technology, NRG de-stress grooves, anti-stress electromagnetic shielding, and Fabric Comprises 40% Recycled Yarns; a comprehensive feature set not commonly combined in standard mattresses. 6. How does Quboid feel (material and firmness)? The mattress provides a medium soft comfort feel through its cube-cell high density foam structure that balances luxury comfort with precise body support. 7. Does Quboid come with a warranty? Yes, the Quboid includes a 10-year warranty and a 10-day replacement guarantee. 8. How to care for Quboid? Use a mattress protector to shield against dust, spillage, and allergens. Do not flip, turn, fold, or iron the mattress. Avoid smoking in bed. Get professional deep cleaning done bi-annually to maintain freshness and hygiene.
